countedBy: lane #207 (opus) from the rectified panorama crops of the brief and the aimed views listed per facade; ribbon convention; a door and a shop window count. Not a blind count; the integrator may re-count.

facades.name: bar street front, south half (Dirk)
facades.note: w02-96 (TMX7316010203-002411_pano_0006_000209, 2022-01-11, 50 px/m, 8 deg oblique). Bottom up: the corner shop under its awning, the goods entrance, three Dirk windows and the entrance bay; twenty square windows on each of storeys 2 and 3 (1.76 m pitch); six ribbon groups on storey 4, one per brick panel (the first at the crop edge). Axes not given: the shop bays and ribbon groups follow the brick panels, not the square-window axes, so the axis count is not a single rhythm.

facades.name: passage recess
facades.note: w09-96 second view (TMX7316010203-002913_pano_0004_000122, 2022): the glazed passage entrance under its canopy and one ribbon per storey between rendered bands; ribbon convention.

facades.name: bar street front, north half (gateway, HEINEKEN)
facades.note: w01-96 (TMX7316010203-001793_pano_0000_007313, 2020-07-07, 45.8 px/m). Bottom up: shop, door, car-park entrance, door, gateway, three steel-framed windows (8); storey 2: 22 square windows and the ribbon over the gateway (23); storey 3: 26 square windows; storey 4: eight ribbon groups. Axes not given: the shop bays and ribbon groups follow the brick panels, not the square-window axes, so the axis count is not a single rhythm.

facades.name: office corner, east face
facades.note: w07-96 (recording_2025-09-29_09-14-27_01666) for the two deep glazed bays on the ground and first floors; the ten storeys of two four-light windows from the aimed views b_20241121_0951_Track23_Sphere_00037 and TMX7316010203-002411_pano_0000_000065.

facades.name: office corner, north face (entrance 79)
facades.note: w08-5 (TMX7316010203-002470_pano_0001_000406, 2022-03-23): revolving-door bay and glazed bay, two deep windows on the first floor, then two four-light windows per storey (TMX7316010203-002411_pano_0000_000083). depthBand 3 keeps the bar end 8.7 m behind out of this elevation. Not mirror-symmetric on the ground: revolving door in the east bay, a fixed glazed bay with the 79 pier in the west.

facades.name: beige front on the Stadhouderskade
facades.note: w04-6 (b_20241121_0951_Track23_Sphere_00028, 2024-11-21, 50 px/m) for the ground and four lower storeys, TMX7316010203-002411_pano_0000_000083 (2022-01-11) for all six: four stone-framed ground windows, six storeys of eight square windows. Axes not given: the four ground windows sit between the upper columns (photo), so the axes are not one rhythm. Near-symmetric only: on the crop the window columns sit 2.2 m from the east edge and 2.06 m from the west, and the ground windows are centred 0.15 m east of the front centre.

facades.name: office block above the beige front
facades.note: TMX7316010203-002411_pano_0000_000083 (2022-01-11, aimed 156 deg, pitch 32): three storeys of large four-light windows above the beige front, four over its width (six counting the two on the corner strip). Near-symmetric only: the crop starts at the beige front edge, the windows run on the office face behind it (1.5 m back) with the parapet hiding the lowest row in the photo.
